Ok, after some more testing:
Automation starts TT and low profile for 15 min.
15 min layer, TT gets back to normal target but profile stays stuck at low %. It needs to be reset manually.

It is not an automation bug.
It also happens with the dev 3 3.1.2 built yesterday.

Just tried a manual profile switch for 10 min and it worked ok.

![Screenshot_20250122_221627_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e453c4b2-fa45-4d35-bdfd-d83937f533ff)

Will try to see what happens if the profile change is triggered by the automation... Theoretically, the "trigger" shouldn't change anything but who knows.

WBB if I catch something that might give you more information.

@MilosKozak I'm closing this issue as all started working ok as before.
FYI, this is what I did ( but have no idea if one of these helped...)
Force close AAPS and clear cache.
Clear APS results and clean (not _reset_ ) db in AAPS.
